title: No Part Library message when the typed description differs only in case
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only, part A, with a description, description 1, in capital letters, so part A is not stocked at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type two spaces, then description 1 in lower case, then two spaces, in the Description field.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  4. Pick any category in the Category field.
  5. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the lower-case text with the spaces.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.
  • No message about the Part Library appears (no "Part created. Linked to" message).

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • One entry is listed for part A, still with description 1 in capital letters.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R9: “When the part was linked to an existing entry whose description differs from the one typed, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces before and after, the system shows "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." For example: "Part created. Linked to N68SL-356 in the Part Library. Its description "BRAKE PAD" was kept."”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "1.3 Number and description typed", "1.4 Saved and linked to the Part Library entry". The design's own words:

  • “Exactly one Part Library entry has the number typed, so the new part links to it (S7-R4, S7-R5). The entry keeps its own description (S7-R6). There is no toast when they match, or when a new entry is created (S7-R10).”
